metadata.status: official-source research completed; school, legal, clinical and operational review pending
metadata.disclaimer: Research aid, not legal advice, clinical protocol, scale license, or deployment approval. Recheck sources and applicability before a live pilot.

sources.title: 中华人民共和国个人信息保护法
sources.issuer: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会; official text hosted by CAC
sources.effective_or_period: Effective 2021-11-01; law, current as of research date subject to any later amendments
provisions: Art. 21
Arts. 23-24
Arts. 28-32
Arts. 38-40
Arts. 44-57
Art. 59
sources.evidence: Arts. 28-31 cover sensitive personal information and under-14 guardian consent; Arts. 55-56 require prior PIPIA for sensitive processing, automated decisions, entrusted processing, provision/public disclosure and cross-border transfer and require keeping the report/records at least three years. Arts. 21, 38-39 address entrusted processing and cross-border provision. Arts. 13-19 establish legal bases, informed voluntary consent, notice, withdrawal and shortest necessary retention.
sources.project_implications: Treat identifiable mental-health and self-harm responses as high-sensitivity pending school legal review; document legal basis and purpose; separate consent where required; conduct PIPIA before processing; assess processor, recipient, model and international data-flow roles.
sources.unresolved: Whether the school, project operator, vendor or multiple parties determine purposes/means; whether a given screening response legally qualifies as health-sensitive data; exact legal basis, age-specific consent representation, and any cross-border exemption/mechanism.

sources.title: 中华人民共和国未成年人保护法
sources.issuer: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会; official text hosted by MOE
provisions: Arts. 2, 4, 7
Arts. 29-30
Art. 72
sources.evidence: Minor means under 18; the law requires special protection, respect for dignity/privacy/personal information and hearing the minor's views. Schools provide psychological-health guidance, puberty education and life education. Under-14 personal information requires parent/guardian consent except where another law/administrative regulation provides otherwise.
sources.project_implications: Use actual age, not school grade, in age-sensitive workflows; explain the process to students in age-appropriate terms; protect privacy and hear the young person's views.
sources.unresolved: How school duties, guardian participation, student assent, parental notification and safety exceptions apply to each proposed school, age group and service purpose.

sources.title: 中华人民共和国教育部令第50号：未成年人学校保护规定
provisions: provisions on student information disclosure and confidentiality in professional cooperation
sources.evidence: Applies to ordinary primary/secondary and secondary vocational schools protecting enrolled minors. Art. 32 requires school mental-health management and early-detection/timely-intervention mechanisms and qualified/part-time school counseling or professional support. The rules prohibit unlawful disclosure of student information and require confidentiality agreements in professional-service cooperation to protect student and family privacy.
sources.project_implications: For covered schools, document school policy, early detection/intervention ownership, service capacity, vendor confidentiality and student-information access controls.
sources.unresolved: Confirm school type and exact clause mapping with counsel; do not apply this regulation as a blanket rule for universities or adult students.

sources.title: 教育部等十七部门关于印发《全面加强和改进新时代学生心理健康工作专项行动计划（2023—2025年）》的通知
sources.effective_or_period: Its expressly stated action-plan period was 2023-2025; that target period has elapsed as of this research date. Do not describe it as the current implementation cycle.
provisions: The plan’s stated 2023-2025 scope, school-family-society coordination, monitoring, counseling and intervention goals
sources.evidence: The document title and action-plan text explicitly define the plan as 2023-2025, including targets due in 2025.
sources.project_implications: May be cited as historical policy context or for continuity, but current-cycle planning should cite the 2025 MOE measures and the 2026-2030 cross-sector plan as applicable.
sources.unresolved: Whether a later national or local implementation document modifies or carries forward any specific provision for a particular school.

sources.title: 教育部办公厅关于印发《进一步加强中小学生心理健康工作十条措施》的通知
sources.effective_or_period: Implementation notice; no fixed end date stated in the notice; applicable to primary/secondary education, scope to be confirmed for the project
provisions: Measures 5-10, especially Measure 6 (monitoring and early warning), 7 (staffing/training/referral), 10 (interdepartmental protection)
sources.evidence: Measure 6 calls for a monitoring/early-warning/intervention system, tiered response, and says each student generally should receive no more than one psychological assessment per school year. Measures 7 and 10 describe a school counselor/teacher/psychiatrist service pathway, crisis response plans, and referral pathways.
sources.project_implications: For a primary/secondary pilot, specify assessment frequency, monitoring, tiered response, trained roles, and referral before enabling questionnaires. Confirm whether the proposed activity qualifies as the policy's psychological assessment.
sources.unresolved: Local implementation details, policy application to the exact school/activity, and whether separate legal/ethical approvals are required.

sources.title: 关于印发儿童青少年“五健”促进行动计划（2026—2030年）的通知
sources.issuer: 国家卫生健康委等13部门
provisions: Section II(III), Children's and adolescents' mental-health promotion; assessment/privacy, family education, school-medical referral network
sources.evidence: The 2026-2030 plan asks to improve child/adolescent psychological-health assessment, counseling and classified intervention while strengthening student privacy; it calls for school/medical coordination and referral channels.
sources.project_implications: This is a current-cycle cross-sector policy reference for 2026 onward. Use it to frame privacy, counseling, classification and referral readiness; it does not approve a specific app, questionnaire or data flow.
sources.unresolved: Provincial/local implementing measures, school responsibilities, operational funding, referral capacity and system-specific privacy review.

sources.title: 教育部办公厅关于印发《中小学心理辅导室建设指南》的通知
sources.effective_or_period: Guidance for primary/secondary school counseling rooms; verify current local implementation and do not treat as a statute
provisions: Counseling ethics; measurement use; confidentiality; crisis intervention; referral; records
sources.evidence: The guide states assessments should be conducted with the informed and voluntary participation of the student and guardian, should not be compulsory, and should not label students from test results. It calls for confidentiality and careful storage, but says confidentiality is broken and the homeroom teacher/guardian informed when extreme self-harm/other-harm behavior may occur; it also calls for crisis procedures and referral channels.
sources.project_implications: For K-12 review, prepare separate student/guardian information, voluntary participation and refusal paths, explicit confidentiality limits, controlled records, crisis SOP and referral contacts.
sources.unresolved: Whether and how each guideline provision is currently applied locally; exact adult student and university protocol; professional review of any disclosure exception.

sources.title: 教育部关于印发《中小学心理健康教育指导纲要（2012年修订）》的通知
sources.effective_or_period: Revised school guidance; check current local implementation; not a standalone legal basis for data processing
provisions: Counseling ethics; student informed/voluntary participation; confidentiality; cautious use of tests; referral
sources.evidence: The guidance says counseling should be conducted on an informed and voluntary basis, follow confidentiality and privacy principles, use psychological tests cautiously and avoid forcing students to take them; serious mental-health problems should be recognized and referred to relevant clinical/treatment services.
sources.project_implications: Questionnaire flows need a genuine voluntary route, clear explanation, limited use of scores and an available human referral pathway.
sources.unresolved: Current local adoption, higher-education applicability, and how the specific tool/processing purpose fits the guidance.

sources.title: 儿童个人信息网络保护规定
sources.issuer: 国家互联网信息办公室等; State Council Gazette official publication
sources.effective_or_period: Departmental rules for network operators handling children's personal information; effective 2019-10-01; reconcile with later laws/rules
sources.evidence: Rules cover child-specific network personal-information notices, guardian consent, purpose/scope limitation and third-party processing/security evaluation and agreements.
sources.project_implications: Ask counsel whether the platform/operator and processing activity fall within the rules' scope; ensure children's special rules and guardian interface are considered for covered online processing.
sources.unresolved: Applicability to the specific school/platform roles and how these rules interact with PIPL and current network-data regulations.

sources.title: 个人信息出境标准合同办法
sources.issuer: 国家互联网信息办公室
sources.document_number: 国家互联网信息办公室令第13号
sources.effective_or_period: Effective 2023-06-01, as updated/affected by later cross-border provisions
provisions: Arts. 4-8
sources.evidence: The standard-contract route has eligibility thresholds and requires a prior PIPIA, execution of the prescribed contract and filing within ten working days after effectiveness; the rules prohibit quantity splitting to evade required security assessment.
sources.project_implications: Inventory actual provider region, recipients and cumulative transfer volumes; determine the applicable transfer mechanism rather than assuming all transfers use one route.
sources.unresolved: Whether a vendor call constitutes a transfer, recipient roles, data category/volume, current eligibility and applicable exemption/mechanism.

sources.title: 国家互联网信息办公室公布《促进和规范数据跨境流动规定》
sources.issuer: 国家互联网信息办公室
sources.effective_or_period: Effective upon promulgation; applies to relevant data export activities subject to its conditions
provisions: Exemptions and thresholds for security assessment, standard contract, and certification routes
sources.evidence: The CAC explains specific exemptions and thresholds for some data export activities; for example, the under-100,000-person exemption described there excludes sensitive personal information. Other enumerated contractual/emergency scenarios have separate conditions.
sources.project_implications: Do not state that every vendor/API use automatically requires the same transfer mechanism or that small volumes of sensitive mental-health data automatically qualify for the ordinary-data exemption. Counsel must apply the exact facts and current rule text.
sources.unresolved: Actual sensitivity classification, hosting/log/support locations, transfer path, cumulative volumes, responsible entity, and any narrowly applicable exception.

sources.title: Youth ASQ Toolkit
sources.issuer: U.S. National Institute of Mental Health (NIMH/NIH)
sources.effective_or_period: U.S. clinical screening resources; not Chinese law or a school deployment authorization
provisions: Youth screening resources, Brief Suicide Safety Assessment, emergency/inpatient/outpatient clinical pathways
sources.evidence: The toolkit provides youth screening resources and setting-specific clinical pathways, BSSA guides, worksheets, scripts and caregiver materials, demonstrating that a screen should connect to further assessment and disposition pathways.
sources.project_implications: Use only as a process-design reference for staffing, follow-up and disposition; do not copy protected questionnaire content, U.S. hotlines or protocols as local service instructions.
sources.unresolved: Local clinical adaptation, qualified personnel, Chinese referral paths, legal rules and tool-use permissions.

sources.title: Youth Outpatient Brief Suicide Safety Assessment Guide
sources.issuer: U.S. National Institute of Mental Health (NIMH/NIH)
sources.effective_or_period: U.S. clinical workflow for youth age 10-24 following positive ASQ; not a Chinese school clinical standard
provisions: Positive-screen follow-up, trained clinical assessor, urgent evaluation/disposition, follow-up
sources.evidence: Guide identifies mental-health clinicians/medical professionals as intended assessors; current suicidal thoughts call for urgent evaluation and not leaving the patient alone; disposition includes referral and follow-up. It distinguishes a positive screen from a complete assessment.
sources.project_implications: Supports the operational safety principle that positive responses need an accountable human assessment and disposition, not merely an automated score or asynchronous inbox. Adapt through local professional review.
sources.unresolved: Local scope of practice, emergency pathway, school staffing, guardian communication and response times.

sources.title: FREE Training for Individuals and Systems; Columbia Lighthouse Project
sources.issuer: Columbia Lighthouse Project / Columbia University-affiliated project
sources.effective_or_period: Tool-owner training information; not Chinese law or a substitute for local qualification rules
provisions: General tool training; separate requirements for research and clinical trials
sources.evidence: The project says general use does not require training or mental-health experience but training is helpful; research and clinical-trial uses have distinct requirements.
sources.project_implications: Do not misstate that training is legally mandatory for all users; still require school-approved role-specific training, practice, competence checks and supervision for risk-response staff as an operational safeguard.
sources.unresolved: Selected instrument/version, license and training conditions for intended use; local professional and research requirements.

sources.title: 校内运营与隐私流程（项目草案）
sources.effective_or_period: Internal draft; status marked pending school responsible-person confirmation
provisions: Pilot privacy, data retention/deletion, crisis response and responsible-role checklist
sources.evidence: The draft says crisis contacts/service schedules, escalation times, retention/deletion basis, responsible roles and pilot scope remain unconfirmed; the system must not be described as an always-on crisis service.
sources.project_implications: Do not enable self-harm item collection until real named school owners, monitoring hours, backup response and referral channels exist and are disclosed.
sources.unresolved: All real school roles, service windows, contacts, record retention/deletion, incident response and pilot approval.

sources.title: AI评测与校内试点方案（项目草案）
sources.effective_or_period: Internal draft; synthetic tooling exists; school pilot and professional review pending
provisions: Pilot preconditions, synthetic evaluation status, unconfirmed operators, model and retention choices
sources.evidence: Project record states no real model output, actual student dialogue, treatment outcome or school pilot has been collected; professional review, staffing and approved retention are pending.
sources.project_implications: Keep proposed sample sizes, costs, staff names, outcome thresholds and real model results blank until supplied and approved.
sources.unresolved: Professional review, actual school pilot approval, provider/version, operational service hours, budget, recruitment and data retention.

sources.title: 求助闭环与项目补齐验收
sources.effective_or_period: Internal technical delivery record; expressly not a production or school-approval record
provisions: No real model evaluation, professional or school approval, staffed crisis contact, retention policy or production release
sources.evidence: The record distinguishes local technical validation from staffed service, real-model evaluation, school responsibility confirmation and production approval; it reports that crisis contacts and retention/deletion rules remain to be supplied by the school.
sources.project_implications: This research deliverable is evidence preparation only; all operational and organizational facts remain awaiting confirmation.
sources.unresolved: School approval, actual staffed response, provider evaluation, professional review, privacy retention/deletion and production controls.
